item.title: Re: I have an Idea.
item.content:encoded:
Maybe if we introduce a few miniature planets produced by the rubix cube, maybe they would be turned into moons or planets for the inhabitants to colonize? Maybe they would think of us as kind caregivers than hostile overlords?

Why would the SCP-756 system accept new bodies? It does not seem to interact with the researchers that have entered its cell, or their gravitatory pull would have altered their orbits massively.

Also, introducing planets to a system already having some would have lots of extremely interesting and complicated consequences (mostly related to the gravitatory pull of these recently introduced planetary bodies and the alterations they would cause on the currently existing planets of this system).

As for the SCP itself… it's evocative, sure. But I'd love to know how fast the miniature planets move across their orbits if we can actually observe them. I mean, how long is a year to them? 100 years of an empire did not mean a lot to us, did this planet rotate around its star even once in this time?

Also, lacking the Incident report. Also, it strains my credibility that several planets exist in several distances of their star and simultaneously support life, but that is just me being a nitpicker. Also, is "incendiary death" a technical term?

Edit: And the Addendum. Goddammit, the addendum. :(

No vote, sorry.

item.title: I have an Idea.
item.content:encoded:
SCP-345: The miniature planet making rubix cube & SCP-756: The Miniaturized Planetary System.

Maybe if we introduce a few miniature planets produced by the rubix cube, maybe they would be turned into moons or planets for the inhabitants to colonize? Maybe they would think of us as kind caregivers than hostile overlords?

But since the rubix cube planets are missing iron, aluminium,and nickel and since we can open it and place items of said missing material in it. Maybe, just maybe it would produce and atmosphere and or life? That would be amazing if we did! Just think of the possibilities we could use it for?

Like studying effects of gaining a moon or losing one, or climate effects after a large impact or anything else the possibilities could be endless!

I would gladly do this if I had the chance!

I liked this SCP until I thought about it. The timescales and sizes really urkes me. Especially how the time ratio seems to go from 2-5mil:1 to 86k:1. Also that in those scales a pebble would be the size of a quark. The only way this could work in my head is if there is a temporal and spatial anomaly surrounding this system and if the temporal ratio started to drastically slow down with the evolution of sentient life.
Also, anything in the containment room or entering the room would be observable from the planets by the light of the star.
